description: Use this policy if you want Windows Defender Security Center to only display notifications which are considered critical. If you disable or do not configure this setting, Windows Defender Security Center will display critical and non-critical notifications to users. NoteIf Suppress notification is enabled then users will not see critical or non-critical messages. Value type is integer. Supported operations are Add, Get, Replace and Delete.

options.displayName: (Disable) Windows Defender Security Center will display critical and non-critical notifications to users..
options.description: (Disable) Windows Defender Security Center will display critical and non-critical notifications to users..

options.displayName: (Enable) Windows Defender Security Center only display notifications which are considered critical on clients.
options.description: (Enable) Windows Defender Security Center only display notifications which are considered critical on clients.
